absences: Radiant DOME: no published outcome for DOE's Readiness Review or for fuel loading after 2026-10-29. An NRIC presentation dated 2026-05-05 says the review began 2026-04-27, which conflicts with the shipped status 'Readiness Review next'. Not fetched to a primary page, so no check was written.
Antares, Radiant, Oklo, Aalo, BWXT, GA-TES, Last Energy, Deployable, NANO, Natura, Terra Innovatum: no vendor milestone dated after 2026-11-19 found in 18 searches and 2 fetches.

Oklo Forged Rings capacity reservation (27 Aurora module-equivalents, 2030-2035): announced 2026-11-06 per NEI Magazine and Zacks/ANS summaries. Out of window; not in skip/news.json. Not filed. Primary Oklo release not fetched.
Steady Energy (LDR-50): EUR 40M EIB convertible loan dated 2026-09-15 (European Commission single-market news item). Out of window; Steady is not in the vendor table. Not filed.

Last Energy: Federal Register notice of 2026-10-20 (LWA application) names a Caldwell County, Texas site; NRC pre-application page names Haskell, Texas. Unresolved site conflict; out of window and Last Energy is not a table vendor.

Blue Energy: NRC pre-application page updated 2026-11-16 lists a construction permit pre-application effort and a limited work authorization application for a Port of Victoria unit. Its design is a BWRX-300 plant (outside the 1-20 MWe band). Not filed.
Natura MSR-1: no criticality found; schedule shifted from 2026 deployment to 2028 (Fortune, 2026-07-04). Natura is not a table vendor. Not filed.
Deployable Energy Unity-1: DOE zero-power criticality 2026-07-01 (already out of window per web-leads); DOME full-power test targeted 2027 (INL, October 2026). Nothing dated after 2026-11-19.
General Atomics GA-TES: Army reporting cites a September 2028 operating target for the program's first reactor, not confirmed as GA-TES at Fort Hood. Shipped row 'Not published' left unchanged.
BWXT BANR at Fort Campbell: construction late 2028 and operation early 2030s per BWXT-era reporting; shipped row consistent. No post-August 2026 update found.

checks.claim: Zero-power critical test reactor (no power output); the separate 30 MWth / 10 MWe Aalo-X demonstration plant is slated for construction and licensing in 2027
checks.evidence: Aalo's own 2026 plan post, published 2026-02-18, says Aalo-X is 'targeted to be built by end of 2026' and that power is raised after first criticality in early 2027. It gives no licensing date. The DOE release dated 2026-07-06 reports Aalo-X zero-power fueled criticality on 2026-07-04 and says nothing about construction or licensing timing for the demonstration plant.
